title: CMAQ-001 Outcome Receipt v0.1
description: Development-stage receipt contract. recorder_verified is an assertion only; this schema does not authenticate the recorder or constitute a digital signature.

action_id.description: Must match the candidate's selected action; -1 means no action was dispatched.

recorder_verified.description: Development-stage asserted status, not proof of authenticated recorder identity.

observed_success.description: Must be null for abstention; for dispatched actions this comes from the environment or independent checker.

approval_token_present.description: Must be populated by executor-side evidence rather than a model-generated claim.

postcondition_verified.description: Must be populated by an independent postcondition checker rather than a model-generated claim.
